description: Set the pool and/or spa heater set point (target water temperature), in the system’s own unit (iAqua: °F 34–104 or °C 1–40; eXO: °C within its reported range, pool only). This changes the target only — turning a heater on or off is iaqualink_set_equipment. Re-reads to confirm. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

name: iaqualink_set_temperature
